title: Percona: chaos process-kill + auto-heal
description: Runs `nexus chaos percona process-kill`: pushes nexus-chaos.sh, kills nexus-percona on a non-writer PXC node, observes impact, then restarts it so it rejoins Galera and confirms recovery to green.

observe.what: target=<non-writer pxc node>; observed-impact health table; cluster recovered to GREEN after the node rejoins Galera (Synced)

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync injects a time-boxed fault via nexus-chaos.sh, observes Galera impact, restarts the node, and confirms auto-heal.
